about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A44: more date-night, for-one, crowd, budget, high-protein, pregnancy-friendly and teen-cook dinners.

recipes.title: Date Night Lamb Cutlets with Minted Pea Puree and Roast Potatoes
recipes.summary: Pink-centred lamb cutlets over a bright pea and mint puree with crisp roast potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the potatoes with half the oil and salt for 25 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Simmer the peas for 4 minutes until tender, blend with the butter, mint and a splash of cooking water until smooth.
Rub the cutlets with the garlic and remaining oil and sear for 3 minutes a side, then rest for 3 minutes. Serve on the puree with the potatoes.
notes: Food safety: lamb cutlets are whole cuts: sear all sides and rest, aiming for 63°C for medium or 71°C for well done; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms and Mash
recipes.summary: Golden chicken breasts in a glossy mushroom and marsala sauce with creamy mash.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with half the butter, the milk and half the salt.
Sear the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes a side until golden and cooked to 75°C, then set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and garlic in the remaining butter for 5 minutes, add the marsala and stock and simmer for 5 minutes until syrupy. Return the chicken for 1 minute and serve on the mash.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Seared Scallops with Lemon Butter Linguine
recipes.summary: Golden scallops on lemony linguine with garlic and parsley, a restaurant-style meal for two.
steps: Boil the linguine for 10 minutes until al dente and keep half a cup of water.
Sear the scallops in the oil for 90 seconds a side, until golden outside and just opaque in the centre.
Melt the butter with the garlic for 1 minute, add the lemon zest, juice, linguine and a splash of water and toss with the parsley. Top with scallops.
notes: Food safety: cook scallops until opaque and firm; eat the same day.
Contains gluten, shellfish and milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Creamy Mushroom Gnocchi with Spinach
recipes.summary: Pillowy gnocchi in a garlic and thyme mushroom cream, finished with spinach.
steps: Boil the gnocchi for 3 minutes until they float and drain.
Cook the mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then the cream and salt and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss through the gnocchi and spinach until wilted and top with the cheese.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sesame Greens and Rice
recipes.summary: Sweet-savoury miso salmon with bok choy and steamed rice.
steps: Stir the miso, mirin and honey together and brush over the salmon.
Grill or bake at 220°C for 10 minutes, until caramelised and the fish flakes.
Pan-fry the bok choy in the sesame oil for 3 minutes until tender and serve with the salmon, rice and sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook salmon until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat leftovers cold within 1 day.
Contains fish, soy, sesame and gluten.

recipes.title: Date Night Steak Diane with Green Beans
recipes.summary: Seared eye fillet in a quick Dijon, cream and Worcestershire pan sauce.
steps: Season the steaks and sear in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest on a plate for 5 minutes.
Soften the onion in the butter for 3 minutes, add the brandy and simmer for 1 minute, then add the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and cook for 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Steam the beans for 5 minutes until tender and serve with the steak and sauce.
notes: Food safety: whole steaks can be served medium (63°C) after resting; use a clean plate for cooked steak.
Contains milk, mustard, gluten and fish.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thigh with Roast Veg
recipes.summary: A single chicken thigh with potato and broccoli roasted on a small tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato with half the oil and salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the paprika and remaining oil, add to the tray with the broccoli and roast for 20 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the skin is crisp.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the bone with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Ten-Minute Prawn and Veg Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: A quick prawn stir-fry with capsicum and snow peas in a garlic soy sauce, over noodles.
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender and drain.
Stir-fry the capsicum and snow peas in the oil for 3 minutes, add the garlic and prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Add the soy sauce and honey, toss with the noodles for 1 minute.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; eat the same day.
Contains shellfish, egg, gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Lamb Mince Flatbread Pizza
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb mince on a flatbread with feta and yoghurt, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil with the cumin and cinnamon for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Spread the flatbread with tomato paste and top with the lamb, onion and feta.
Bake at 220°C for 8 minutes, until crisp at the edges and the lamb reaches 75°C. Drizzle with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C in the centre; eat the same day.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Ten-Minute Chickpea Curry
recipes.summary: A small-batch curry of chickpeas, tomato and spinach with curry powder, served on rice.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, add the curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add the chickpeas and tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over the rice.
notes: Naturally vegan.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Pan-Fried Fish with Lemon Caper Butter
recipes.summary: A crisp barramundi fillet with lemon caper butter, served with steamed greens and potato.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Pan-fry the fish in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden and opaque all the way through.
Melt the butter with the capers and lemon juice for 1 minute, spoon over the fish and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat the same day.
Contains fish and milk.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Slow-Cooker Chicken Tinga Tacos for Twelve
recipes.summary: Shredded chipotle chicken with tomato and onion, piled into corn tortillas with toppings.
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, tomatoes, chipotle, oregano and salt in the slow cooker. Cook on low for 5 hours, until the chicken reaches 75°C and shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and stir it through the sauce.
Warm the tortillas and serve with sour cream, coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Baked Ziti for Ten
recipes.summary: A big dish of pasta, rich tomato sauce, ricotta and melted mozzarella with sausage.
steps: Boil the penne for 8 minutes until just tender and drain.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the sausage meat and brown for 8 minutes, then add the tomatoes, oregano and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Mix the pasta with the sauce and ricotta in a large dish, top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Food safety: pork sausage meat must reach 75°C in the centre; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Honey Soy Chicken Wings for a Party
recipes.summary: Sticky oven-baked wings with a honey, soy and garlic glaze, sized for ten.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil and toss the wings through.
Roast on two lined trays for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky, golden and cooked to 75°C.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C with no pink at the bone; wash hands and trays after touching raw chicken, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains soy, gluten and sesame.

recipes.title: Crowd-Pleasing Vegetable and Chickpea Biryani for Ten
recipes.summary: A fragrant baked rice dish with vegetables, chickpeas and whole spices.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 12 minutes until golden, add the garlic, ginger and spice mix for 1 minute, then the carrot, cauliflower, chickpeas and yoghurt and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, stock and salt, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Fold in the peas and coriander, cover for 5 minutes and fluff before serving.
notes: Contains milk. Use coconut yoghurt for vegan.
Cool leftover rice within 1 hour and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Budget Smoky Cannellini and Pasta Pot
recipes.summary: Tinned beans, pasta and tomato simmered in one pan with smoked paprika, for about $2 a serve.

items: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, add the paprika for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes, beans, water and salt.
Bring to the boil, add the pasta and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring, until the pasta is tender and the sauce is thick.
Scatter with the grated cheese and serve straight from the pan while hot.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Budget Potato and Egg Curry with Roti
recipes.summary: Hard-boiled eggs and potato in a tomato and spice gravy, served with warm roti.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the curry powder for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, potato, water and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until the potato is tender and the gravy is thick, then add the halved eggs and warm for 2 minutes.
Warm the roti and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs for 10 minutes until the yolk is firm; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains egg and gluten. About $2.40 a serve.

recipes.title: Budget Sausage Hotpot with Mash
recipes.summary: Pork sausages, baked beans and carrot in a savoury gravy over cheap creamy mash.
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil for 6 minutes, slice them and cook the onion and carrot in the pan for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, stock and Worcestershire, return the sausages and simmer for 20 minutes, until thick and the sausages reach 75°C.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, mash with the butter and milk and serve with the hotpot.
notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten, milk and fish. About $3 a serve.

recipes.title: High-Protein Greek Yoghurt Chicken Pasta Bake
recipes.summary: Chicken, wholemeal pasta, spinach and a creamy Greek yoghurt sauce for a lighter, high-protein bake.
steps: Boil the pasta for 9 minutes until just tender and drain.
Cook the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes until white throughout, add the garlic, tomatoes, oregano and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the spinach, yoghurt and pasta.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Pregnancy-Friendly Slow-Cooked Beef and Vegetable Casserole
recipes.summary: A slow-cooked, iron-rich beef casserole with vegetables, cooked well beyond medium.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 6 minutes and place in the slow cooker with the onion, carrot, celery, garlic, paste, stock, potato and salt.
Cook on low for 7 hours, until the beef is fall-apart tender.
Stir in the peas for 10 minutes until hot.
notes: Food safety: beef must be cooked until fall-apart tender and well above 75°C; reheat leftovers until steaming hot and eat within 3 days. Pregnancy-friendly.

recipes.title: Pregnancy-Friendly Baked Chicken and Vegetable Risotto
recipes.summary: An oven-baked risotto with chicken, pumpkin and spinach, cooked until steaming hot.
steps: Cook the chicken and onion in the oil in an ovenproof pot for 6 minutes, add the pumpkin and rice for 1 minute.
Pour in the hot stock and salt, bring to a simmer, cover and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and top with cheese.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; use pasteurised cheese and reheat leftovers until steaming hot, eating within 1 day. Pregnancy-friendly.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Easy Teen Cook: Sheet-Pan Chicken Nuggets and Wedges
recipes.summary: Homemade crumbed chicken nuggets and potato wedges baked on one tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato wedges with half the oil, salt and paprika on a tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Dip the chicken in egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with the remaining oil, and add to the tray.
Bake for 20 minutes, turning once, until the nuggets are golden and reach 75°C and the wedges are crisp. Serve with tomato sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; wash hands after handling raw chicken and egg, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains egg and gluten. A good first recipe for a teen: ask an adult to help with the hot oven.
